scope: source-only local transport regression; NOT hosted product acceptance, no provider/VM/credential/workflow/service action
rootCause: Both probes awaited route.fetch (buffers full body) for a never-ending HTTP 200 text/event-stream response: one rejected on context disposal, the other timed out at 30000ms. The sanitized hosted receipt was not read in this worker; the cause is taken from the brief and confirmed from source lines (route.fetch + maxRedirects:0 on all pinned-BFF requests).

fix.sharedTransport: scripts/lib/pinned-browser-bff-bearer.mjs (dependency-free; replaces the duplicated originOf/isLoopbackOrigin/pinnedTargetProblem/installPinnedBffBearer in both probes)
fix.sse: GET + Accept text/event-stream: authenticated header-only node probe (redirect not followed, body never read); 3xx is fulfilled so the browser follows it unauthenticated, otherwise route.continue({headers}) streams natively
fix.closedTarget: closed/disposed-target errors end the handler quietly; any other transport error aborts that request (no unhandled rejection, not swallowed silently)

findingDuringWork: route.continue({headers}) alone replays the bearer to a cross-origin redirect in this Chromium (reproduced by the new spec, foreign server saw Authorization) and a second non-BFF route is not invoked for the redirected request. Hence the header probe.
